verdict.rationale: The evidence shows drafts are kept separate from the live flow: edits don't take effect until you click Publish. The MCP docs also mention that AI assistants can 'test automations', which implies some pre-live testing. Nothing describes testing with sample or pinned data or inspecting each step's input and output. Missing for 10: sample/pinned test data, per-step input/output inspection, documented step-test UI in the builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
